name: Yuki-onna

actions.name: Frozen Touch
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or have their movement halved until end of their next turn.

actions.name: Blizzard Breath
actions.effect: Cone of freezing wind. All targets in a 9m cone must pass PHYS save. On failure, they take full damage and are frozen in place (restrained) for 1 round.

actions.name: Life Drain Kiss
actions.effect: Can only target a charmed, restrained, or willing creature. The Yuki-onna heals for half the damage dealt.

actions.name: Entrancing Beauty
actions.effect: One target within medium range must pass WILL save or be charmed for 1 round, moving toward the Yuki-onna on their turn.

reactions.name: Snow Veil
reactions.effect: When targeted by an attack, the Yuki-onna dissolves into a flurry of snow, gaining +5 to all defenses against that attack. She reforms at the start of her next turn.

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.desc: The Yuki-onna glides over snow and ice effortlessly. She leaves no tracks and can walk on frozen water regardless of its thickness.

traits.name: Snowstorm Aura
traits.desc: The area within 9m of the Yuki-onna is lightly obscured by swirling snow. Non-cold-immune creatures starting their turn in the aura take 1d6 cold damage.

lore: Yuki-onna are hauntingly beautiful spirits of winter storms. They appear during blizzards, luring travelers with their ethereal beauty before draining their life force with a frozen kiss. Some tales speak of Yuki-onna who fell in love with mortals, sparing them from the cold.
